Chicago }} '''Derrick Martell Rose''' (born [[October 4]] [[1988]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[point guard]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[University of Memphis|University of Memphis Tigers]]. ==Early years== At [[Simeon Career Academy]], Rose led his team to two straight State Championships. Simeon became the first [[Chicago Public League]] team to win back to back titles. During his senior year he led Simeon past then #1 ranked [[Oak Hill Academy]], 78-75 on national TV. That loss turned out to be Oak Hill's sole loss on the season. In that game, Rose had 28 points, 9 [[Assist (basketball)|assists]], and 8 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]]. He played in the Jordan Brand game and the [[McDonald's All-American]] game. Rose also played for [[Team USA]] in the [[Nike Hoop Summit]]. Rose's career record in high school was 120-12, which is over 90%. He was widely considered the top point guard prospect of the 2007 high school class. His [[Amateur Athletic Union|AAU]] team was the Mean Street Express. ==College career== Rose played for the [[University of Memphis|University of Memphis Tigers]] under coach [[John Calipari]]. As a freshman he led his #1 seeded Tigers to the [[2008 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2008 NCAA Men's Final Four]], and to the NCAA Championship Game. However, they lost to the [[University of Kansas]] in [[Overtime (sports)|overtime]], 75-68. On [[April 15]], [[2008]], Rose announced that he would declare for the [[2008 NBA Draft]].http://www.sportsnetwork.com/default.asp?c=sportsnetwork&page=cbask/news/AEN4144954.htm The [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] has measured him officially as {{convert|6|ft|2.25|in|cm|abbr=on|lk=on}} tall.[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2008/news/story?id=3424913 NBA releases actual heights for Beasley, Rose] ==Personal== Rose goes by the nickname "Pooh". This name originated from when Rose's [[grandmother]] referred to him as such when he was an infant, referencing the fact that he looked like [[Winnie-the-Pooh]]. Rose has a tattoo on his left [[Biceps brachii muscle|biceps]] depicting a wizard holding a staff in one hand and a basketball in the other. The entire image is below the word "Poohdini".[http://thenperiod.wordpress.com/2008/05/18/the-great-poohdini/ The Great Poohdini « The N. Period] This is ironic because Rose has a [[phobia]] of needles[http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/chi-30-bits-ncaamar30,1,1010599.story Derrick Rose hates needles - Basketball, NCAA Tournament - chicagotribune.com], even refusing to get stitches as a result. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.drosehoops.com/rose/index DRoseHoops.com] Derrick's Official Website *[http://www.derrickrose.com DerrickRose.com] *[http://scout.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=8&c=1&nid=1349804 Scout.com Profile] *[http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewprospect.asp?sport=2&pr_key=30307 Rivals.com Profile] *[http://nbadraft.net/admincp/profiles/derrickrose.html NBADraft.net Profile] *[http://www.draftexpress.com/viewprofile.php?p=1068 DraftExpress Profile] *[http://usabasketball.com/biosmen/derrick_rose_bio.html USA Basketball Bio] *[http://www.collegehoopsnet.com/new/story/derrick_rose_nba_draft_profile41816 CollegeHoops.net Bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Rose, Derrick}} [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:People from Chicago, Illinois]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:American basketball players]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[it:Derrick Rose]] [[zh:德里克·罗斯]]
